description: Use this when the person tells you a set they did. Give the session and slot from get_today or get_session, and the load and reps they said. Never invent a number. loadUnit kg or lb as they said it (label for a machine's own numbers); rir only if they say it. setNumber null logs the next set. Comes back with an Undo. Do not use to correct a set already logged; use edit_set.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

name: log_set
title: Log a set
